description: This file defines the interface ClientConfig which provides configuration settings for the Connectivity service's client, including timeout durations, backoff strategies, and retry counts.

classes.name: ClientConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods related to connectivity client behavior.

classes.name: ClientConfig.ClientConfigValue
classes.description: Enum containing configuration keys and default values for ClientConfig settings.

methods.name: getConnectingMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the initial minimum timeout for establishing a connection to a remote system.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for reconnect attempts to a remote system.

methods.name: getSubscriptionManagerTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration that SubscriptionManager waits for search commands.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration after a failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration after a failure.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retries for establishing a connection.

methods.name: getTestingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for testing a new connection.
